authority_note: All calculations use provisional or design-derived geometry. PlanX results are design-network diagnostics and are excluded from formal existing-condition or official accessibility metrics.

geo_mcp.limitations: Routing plausibility failed; ORS isochrone and elevation remained blocked; OSM is background only.

blender_mcp.source: BBBike/OpenStreetMap background extract plus agent-generated design overlays
blender_mcp.limitations: Functions and facade details are inferred design representations, not official uses, surveyed facades, statutory heights, or engineering evidence.

network_isochrones.reason: No cleared routable pedestrian network and no configured routing API key.

pedshed_ratio.reason: Requires a verified pedestrian network and accessible entrances.

gsi.limitation: Uses design footprints and provisional site geometry only.

fsi.reason: Approved floor counts and total floor area are unavailable.

osr.reason: FSI and verified residential population are unavailable.

network_centrality.reason: Concept centerlines are not a complete pedestrian network.
